fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Looking at a data science master's at Manchester? Here is what we know about cost, entry and the 2027 deadlines.

Manchester's closest course to an MSc Data Science is the **MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (Computer Science Data Informatics)**. It lasts **1 year**, full-time and in person, for 2027 entry.

**The most important fact for you:** this course is for students with a strong computer science background. It is not a conversion course.

You take **180 credits**: six mandatory course units, including a research project worth **60 credits**, and three optional units, from statistical foundations to data analysis and GIS.

For the wider university, see our [University of Manchester page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-manchester).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** Manchester asks for a high 2:1 honours degree or the overseas equivalent. It typically expects a First or strong Upper Second in Computer Science, or a joint degree with at least **50%** Computer Science content. You need solid programming and software development skills.

**Indian marks.** Manchester's India page says taught master's applicants need a First Class from a reputable university. The minimum typically ranges from **60-80%** overall, depending on the university.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course asks for **IELTS 7** overall with no component below **6.5**. Other accepted results include:

- TOEFL iBT: **100** with no section under 22, or **5** overall from 2026, with no subskill under **4.5**
- PTE Academic: **76** overall, with no component under 70

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Manchester's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

**Tuition: NOT CONFIRMED.** The course page shows no fee for this course, and Manchester's fees page says fees are on each course profile. We checked the page as plain text and in a browser on 4 November 2026. Ask the admissions team for the 2027 fee.

Manchester is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. Without the tuition fee we cannot give a full first-year total. These are the visa costs you will have on top of tuition.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | NOT CONFIRMED |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total without tuition** | **£12,549** |

The sum is £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £12,549. Add tuition once it is published. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Manchester asks for a tuition fee deposit before it issues a CAS for a one-year taught master's. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs. The minimum deposit is **£2,500**.

**Application fee.** No fee is listed on the course page.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

- **Global Futures Scholarship for India:** **£12,000** off the published overseas tuition fee. It is for self-funded applicants domiciled in India with an offer for a full-time, on-campus master's starting September 2027. You must hold an offer and submit the online form by **25 April 2027**. Half the awards are made by **15 March 2027** and the rest by **1 June 2027**. Applicants whose bachelor's degree is from outside South Asia are not eligible. Read the [India scholarships page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/).
- **Alumni discount:** Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan graduates get **10%** off master's tuition.

## Deadlines and intakes

Manchester uses staged admissions for September 2027 entry. You can apply at any stage, but earlier stages have more places.

| Stage | Application received by | Update by |
|---|---|---|
| Stage 1 | 6 December 2026 | 19 February 2027 |
| Stage 2 | 1 March 2027 | 2 May 2027 |
| Stage 3 | 4 May 2027 | 18 June 2027 |
| Stage 4 | 4 July 2027 | 30 July 2027 |

Later applications are considered only if places remain. Courses can close when full, so apply early.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** You need a strong computer science degree with high marks.
2. **Take your English test.** Aim for IELTS 7 with no part below 6.5, or an accepted equivalent.
3. **Apply online** before your target stage date. Start from the [course page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/22195/msc-data-science-and-artificial-intelligence-computer-science-data-informatics/).
4. **Apply for the Global Futures Scholarship.** The form is emailed after you get an offer. Submit it by 25 April 2027.
5. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** The university then issues your CAS.
6. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
7. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your BTech, BE or BSc is in computer science and you have strong marks
- you want a data and AI course built on computing
- you can apply early in the staged cycle

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is not in computer science, because the course is not a conversion course
- you need IELTS below 7, because the course asks for 7 with no part below 6.5
- you need the exact fee now, because the 2027 fee is not on the page

## Sources

- [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student). Checked on 4 November 2026.

- [Academic Technology Approval Scheme](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme). Checked on 4 November 2026.

faq_json.q: Does Manchester offer a plain MSc Data Science?
faq_json.a: Its closest course is the MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (Computer Science Data Informatics), a 1-year course for computing graduates.

faq_json.q: How much does it cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: The 2027 tuition fee is not on the course page. On top of tuition, the visa needs £10,827 living money shown, a £558 fee and a £1,164 health surcharge.

faq_json.q: Can I apply without a computer science degree?
faq_json.a: Usually not. Manchester expects a First or strong Upper Second in Computer Science, or a joint degree with at least 50% Computer Science.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Global Futures Scholarship gives £12,000 off tuition to self-funded students domiciled in India. Submit the form by 25 April 2027.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need?
faq_json.a: IELTS Academic 7 overall with no component below 6.5. The course page does not mention GRE.
